title: The Good Samaritan
summaryZh: 葛理翰牧師呼召會眾公開決志接受耶穌，並邀請電視機前的觀眾一同回應。
lines: Christ can touch your life and make you new and give you eternal life.
基督能觸摸你的生命，使你成為新造的人，並賜給你永生。
And then you'll have the strength and the ability to go out and be a neighbor to those that you should be a neighbor to.
然後你就會有力量和能力走出去，成為那些你理當成為其鄰舍之人的鄰舍。
You say, "What do I have to do?"
你會問：「我必須做什麼呢？」
You have to say, "God, I'm sorry I've sinned.
你必須說：「神啊，我為我犯了罪感到抱歉。
Lord, I'm willing to change my way of life.
主啊，我願意改變我的生活方式。
Lord, I receive You into my heart by faith, and I do it openly."
主啊，我憑著信心接待祢進入我的心，並且我是公開地這麼做。」
Every person Jesus called, He called openly and publicly in the New Testament.
在新約聖經中，耶穌所呼召的每一個人，祂都是公開且在眾人面前呼召的。
That's the reason I'm going to ask you to get up right now and come forward, and stand in front of the platform.
這就是為什麼我現在要請你站起來，走到前面，站在講台前。
I want you to get up and come and stand and say tonight, "I want eternal life.
我希望你今晚站起來，走上前來站著說：「我想要永生。
I want to know I'm going to heaven.
I want Christ in my heart.
I want a new relationship with Him."
我想與祂建立全新的關係。」
You get up and come right now, we're going to wait.
你現在就站起來走上前，我們會等你。
Just as I am, and waiting not to rid my soul of one dark blot.
照我本相，無善足稱，不待洗淨哪怕一處的黑斑。
As hundreds are responding to Mr. Graham's invitation to make a public commitment to Jesus Christ, you can make that same commitment right where you are.
當數百人正在回應葛理翰先生的呼召，公開決志信靠耶穌基督時，你在你所在之處也可以做同樣的決志。
Just pick up the phone and call the number you see on your screen.
只要拿起電話，撥打你螢幕上看到的號碼。
Special friends are waiting to talk with you and pray with you about this most important decision.
有特別的朋友正等著與你交談，為你這個最重要的決定與你一起禱告。
You that have been watching by television can see that scores of people are coming from every part of this great stadium to make their commitment to Jesus Christ.
你們在電視機前觀看的人可以看到，有許多人正從這個大體育場的各個角落走過來，決志信靠耶穌基督。
And where you are: in a living room, in a hotel room, in a bar, wherever, you can make that same commitment to Christ.
無論你身在何處：在客廳、在飯店房間、在酒吧，無論哪裡，你都可以向基督做同樣的決志。
God help you to make that commitment.
願神幫助你做出那個決志。
And be sure and go to church next Sunday.
並且務必在下個星期天去教會。
If you just prayed that prayer with my father, or if you have any questions about a relationship with Jesus Christ, why don't you call the number on the screen.
如果你剛才跟我的父親一起作了那個禱告，或者你對與耶穌基督的關係有任何疑問，何不撥打螢幕上的號碼呢？
There will be someone there to talk with you, pray with you and answer those questions.
會有專人在那裡與你交談、陪你禱告，並回答那些問題。
If you would like to commit your life to Jesus Christ, please call us right now, toll free at 1-877-772-4559.
如果你願意將你的生命交託給耶穌基督，請現在就打電話給我們，免付費專線 1-877-772-4559。
Or you can write to us at: Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, NC 28201.
或者你可以寫信給我們，地址是：Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, NC 28201。
Or you can contact us on the web 24/7 at peacewithgod.tv.
或者你可以全天候 24 小時在 peacewithgod.tv 網站上聯絡我們。
We'll get the same helps to you that we give to everyone who responds at the invitation.
我們會提供給所有回應呼召的人同樣的幫助。
On behalf of Franklin Graham and the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association, thank you for watching and thank you for your prayers.
代表葛福臨以及葛理翰佈道大會，感謝您的收看，也感謝您的代禱。
If you don’t take it to the edge every chance you get, you’re dead already, baby.
如果你不抓住每個機會挑戰極限，你就已經死了，寶貝。
I was in trouble and I didn’t know what to do.
我遇到了麻煩，不知道該怎麼辦。
I knew that I could take on the world.
我知道我可以挑戰全世界。
It’s like you’re in a dream, but not really a dream, this is reality.
這就像你身在夢中，但又不是真的夢，這是現實。
I don’t really believe in all this but I know something crazy is happening right now.
我並不是真的相信這一切，但我知道現在正發生一些瘋狂的事。
